statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and Z86.73
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
